decisions.title: Trails Are for Everyone: Americans with Disabilities Act
decisions.description: Explains the ADA framework for Albuquerque trails, distinguishing recreation trails, outdoor-recreation access routes, shared-use paths, and sidewalks; summarizes access audits, geometry, surfaces, maintenance, documented departures, and accessible mobility-device policies.
processing_notes: The authoritative City PDF is preserved without modification; all 31 slides were text-extracted and representative slides were rendered and visually reviewed.
Presented to GARTC on May 17, 2016; retained separately from routine meeting notices because it is a substantive accessibility guidance presentation.
